title: Entry door declares each action: its seat, its engine claim, its reversal
deviations_from_card: Two commits instead of test->feat: the red tests and the gate cannot be split into separately green commits (route-capability-coverage goes red on either half), so code+tests landed together in one green feat commit, doc second. Also: unknown-action 400 already held before (runPipelineEntryAction answered it); now answered at the door before the seat. The reinstate event read uses listPipelineEventsForEntry(id, 5000, ws) not 50: that read is OLDEST-first with LIMIT, so 50 could cut off the newest event.
notes: Red before: 18 node:test cases across 5 files (entry-actions 6 via missing module, entry-route 3, authz-parity 3, coverage 1, write-capability-gate 5); all green after, full test:unit 10529/10529 green. tsc whole-tree red only on foreign paths (app/features/library/jobs/useJobsList.test.ts, a sibling's in-flight jobs work; kpi-sim/ untracked scratch) - none in this card's files. test:perf red on ~12 task-hub routes at +1 module/+16 KB, none of them import this card's files (my two routes are not in the overage list); the growth comes from siblings' uncommitted app/_lib/db/jobs.ts + contract-constants.generated.ts - no perf raise taken. api:check green without api:docs (auth posture side unchanged). Integration notes: (1) pipeline-api/B rewrites outcomes GET: my gate sits only in POST (requireCapabilityCoded after requireOperator); authz-parity + write-capability-gate pin it, outcomes-route.test.ts untouched. (2) authz-parity ALLOWLIST holds 'route.ts GET' and 'route.ts POST' (app/api/pipeline/route.ts, r06 db-pipeline-store/A debt) and 'events/route.ts GET' (public feed); a stale-row check fails if a listed handler disappears. (3) Follow-up for db-pipeline-store: listReconsiderQueue lists any rejected entry carrying ANY auto_rejected event, so an auto-reject -> reinstate -> hand reject entry still shows in Reconsider but the door now 409s it; the queue should apply the same newest-decision rule (reversibleAutoRejection).
